source: Source: taped and remastered by Monte Barry; Nakamichi 550 portable stereo cassette recorder; taped with Dolby NR on Maxell UD C90 normal bias cassettes Sony ECM-99 single-point stereo mic; mic is hand-held on mic-stand shaft, with arm raised up, FOB;

ai_review.summary: Atmospheric audience recording of a powerful Dark Star‑El Paso‑Eyes‑Dew run, with a mixed first set but a standout second set despite murky sound.
ai_review.review: The show is remembered as a personal favorite, highlighted by an extended Dark Star > El Paso > Eyes > Dew sequence that lifts the crowd to soaring heights. While the first set is described as unremarkable, the second set shines if you can cut through the warm but indistinct recording. The audience‑sourced tape captures the Wall of Sound from all directions, though it lacks clarity for critical listening.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers rate the performance highly (4‑5 stars) but note significant recording muddiness; weighting show quality higher yields a solid mid‑high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm and atmospheric but not clear or distinct; sounds muffled on car stereos, yet conveys the music from all directions.

standout_songs: Dark Star > El Paso > Eyes > Dew
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set considered weak, but second set is a gem that shines despite recording limitations.
